verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a dedicated manage-disputes area, dispute testing in its test environment, and webhooks that report "progress on disputes," which supports some lifecycle tracking. None of the evidence shows how a merchant submits structured chargeback evidence or represents a dispute through to resolution. Missing for 10: documented evidence-submission or representment flow (API or Dashboard), explicit dispute status/stage model through resolution, finance-ops Dashboard workflow for disputes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
